user.title: Sign in to MyGate
user.description: Home Assistant signs in as its own device on your MyGate account and receives visitor alerts directly. MyGate will text you an OTP.

data_description.phone: The number you sign in to MyGate with, without the country code.
data_description.topic: Alerts are published under this prefix, at /notification and /notification_removed. Answers are read from /respond.

otp.title: Enter the OTP
otp.description: Enter the OTP MyGate sent to {phone}. Signing in also registers for MyGate's push alerts, which takes about 10 seconds.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to MyGate again
reauth_confirm.description: MyGate signed this device out. Submit to have MyGate text a new OTP to {phone}.

error.otp_request_failed: MyGate could not send an OTP to this number. Check the number and try again.
error.invalid_otp: That OTP doesn't match. Check the latest message from MyGate.
error.login_failed: MyGate refused the sign-in. See the Home Assistant log for details.
error.push_registration_failed: Could not register for MyGate's push alerts. See the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This MyGate account is already set up.

respond.name: Respond to visitor
respond.description: Approves or denies a visitor waiting at the gate, or asks the guard to keep a delivery at the gate.

action.name: Response
action.description: Leave at gate is only offered for deliveries.

id.name: Alert ID
id.description: The `id` from the MQTT alert. Leave empty to answer the most recent visitor still waiting.

send_test_alert.name: Send test alert
send_test_alert.description: Asks MyGate to push its visitor test alert to Home Assistant only. Answering it doesn't reach MyGate.
